First public release of **Multilingual Audio Studio**: a desktop app that turns English text into
hardware-ready WAV audio in **English, Hindi, Marathi, Bengali, Gujarati and Sanskrit**.

## Download (Windows 10/11, 64-bit)

| File | Use it if… |
|---|---|
| **`MultilingualAudioStudio-v1.0.0-windows-x64.zip`** | **Recommended.** Unzip anywhere and run `MultilingualAudioStudio.exe`. FFmpeg (`ffmpeg.exe`, `ffplay.exe`) is included, so there's nothing else to install. |
| `MultilingualAudioStudio-v1.0.0.exe` | You already have FFmpeg installed and on `PATH` (or will point the app to it). |

No Python installation is needed. An internet connection is required while translating and generating audio.

> **"Windows protected your PC"?** The executable isn't code-signed, so SmartScreen warns on first launch.
> Click **More info → Run anyway**. The first start takes a few seconds while the app unpacks.

## Features

- **Content editor** for six categories (quiz questions, solutions, instructions, state information,
  counting numbers, quiz modes) with live review status per entry.
- **Machine translation** of empty fields, plus a native-speaker review step (CSV export → review → import).
- **Speech preview** in any language, played back in the exact WAV format the device will use.
- **Batch generation**: gTTS → MP3 → FFmpeg → 16-bit PCM WAV (22050 Hz mono by default), 15 parallel workers,
  random request delay, automatic retries.
- **Incremental runs**: unchanged text is skipped, a WAV-format change re-converts from kept MP3s with no
  network calls, and failures are logged to `failed_files.csv` and retried with one click.
- **Firmware-safe output**: `wav/<category>/<language>/<category>_<id>_<language>.wav`.
- **Test runs** into a separate folder, and a **device storage** estimate and warning.
- Import/export of **Python dictionaries** and **CSV**. Projects are saved as a single `.json` file.
- **Sanskrit** is spoken with the Hindi voice (gTTS has no Sanskrit voice).

See the [README](https://github.com/buzzwordExpert/indian_languages_tts#readme) for the full operating guide.
